notes:
Summary: Mid-market ITSM vendor building internal helpdesk/chatbot for enterprise customers and internal ops. Primary objective: replace legacy FAQ + ticket triage with fast streaming chat + tool calling to run simple ops (reset password, query user status). Evaluating Hosted API for quick go-live; leaning toward Dedicated if predictable p95 can be met and price/commit package looks reasonable.

POC details: 2-week POC on Hosted API with small KB (internal KB + Confluence dump). Test cases: password resets (tool call), incident triage, KB lookup. Observations: median first-token ~85-120ms in NA during tests; P95 under synthetic 200RPS concurrency jumped to ~420ms. Tool-calling flow added ~120-200ms overhead. Redwood SE recommended enabling KV prefix caching, smaller batching window for interactive SLOs, and trial quantization profile for cost.

Security/compliance: IT requires SSO/SAML, audit logs surfaced per-request (user/action), retention controls (must be able to set 12mo default, 7yr optional for enterprise customers), KMS integration for keys. Legal flagged data residency for EU enterprise clients. Asked for SOC2 report and pen-test summary.

Commercial: Rough ARR expectation if committed: $60-120k/yr. Team is price sensitive; procurement prefers predictable committed spend (Dedicated) vs usage variability. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions to reduce token cost on KB-heavy flows.

Quotes / rep notes: "We need the bot to feel instantaneous for our agents — if it stalls it's a blocker to adoption." — Maya Lin.  "Auditability is non-negotiable for our compliance customers." — Carlos Vega.

AE to share Dedicated capacity options and a 6/12-month commit pricing matrix. Security team to receive SOC2 docs + architecture whitepaper. Legal to start residency clause draft.
